text.title: Regression Test First Bugfix Workflow — Procedure
text.summary: Eight steps from the alert to the reviewed record: lift the reproducing inputs from the payload, write the red test under tests/regression/ and commit it alone, wait for the failing CI run and check it fails for the alert's reason, write the minimal fix in a separate commit, verify the green run in CI, merge and set the review date at plus 90 days, then close the loop against the alerting tool. The hotfix variant swaps steps 2-4 for a follow-up ticket due within 14 days.

step.name: lift-inputs-from-the-alert
step.input: The Sentry / Datadog / ticket URL with its event payload: exception type and message or wrong output, request body, query parameters, locale, timezone, feature-flag state, record ids.
step.action: Open `templates/skeleton.md.j2`; fill `alert.kind`, `alert.url`, `alert.alert_id`, `alert.observed_outcome` (the exact exception type and message fragment, or the wrong value) and `alert.side_effect` if the bug wrote a row, sent an email or made a charge. Copy the payload fields into `alert.reproducing_inputs`, replacing personal data field-by-field with values of the same shape and listing each in `pii_substitutions[]`. Run the inputs against the unfixed code three times.
step.decision-gate: The same inputs do not reproduce the failure on every run: stop, this is not a regression-test case; route to observability or QA per 06-decision-tree.xml (r-inputs-lifted-from-alert-payload, r-test-is-deterministic-and-located). SLA does not allow a red run before shipping: go to step 8.

step.name: write-the-red-test
step.action: Create `tests/regression/test_<alert-slug>.py` (or the runner's equivalent) with `alert.alert_id` in the docstring. Assert the alert's exception type and message fragment or the wrong value, and, when `side_effect` is set, assert the side effect is absent. Freeze time, stub every external call, seed randomness.
step.decision-gate: An assertion of the shape `raises(Exception)` or "something failed" is rewritten before commit (r-test-fails-for-the-alerts-reason).

step.name: commit-the-test-alone
step.input: The red test file; the alert URL.
step.action: Commit the test file with no production code in the commit and the alert URL in the commit message. Push and record the commit hash.
step.decision-gate: Production code already touched on the branch: reset it, commit the test first, re-apply the fix later as its own commit (r-red-test-committed-before-fix).

step.name: confirm-the-red-run-in-ci
step.input: The CI run for the test-only commit.
step.action: Wait for CI. Read the failure: it must show the exception type or wrong value from `alert.observed_outcome`, not an import error or fixture typo. Re-run the job twice more on the same commit.
step.decision-gate: The failure reason differs from the alert: fix the test, recommit, wait again. The test passes on any of the runs: it is flaky or does not reproduce the bug; back to step 2 (r-test-fails-for-the-alerts-reason, r-test-is-deterministic-and-located).

step.name: write-the-minimal-fix
step.input: The red test; the root cause.
step.action: Change only what turns the test green, in a separate commit on top of the test commit. Leave the test's assertions untouched; if an assertion was wrong, change it in its own commit with a written reason and show the test failing again on the fix's parent. Move any refactor to a separate PR and record its URL.
step.decision-gate: The fix diff includes lines inside the red test's assertions: split it before review (r-fix-is-minimal-and-assertions-untouched).

step.name: verify-green-in-ci
step.input: The CI run of the complete PR.
step.action: Take `passed` from the CI result, never from a local run. Confirm the regression test ran: no `skip`, `xfail` or `retry` marker, and the test is inside the job that ran.
step.decision-gate: The regression test was skipped, marked xfail or excluded from the job: the PR does not merge (r-ci-shows-red-then-green).

step.name: merge-and-date-the-review
step.input: The green PR; the developer's handle; today's date.
step.action: Merge. Set `owner`, `review.merged_at` and `review.next_review_at` = `merged_at` + 90 days. Mark the alert resolved in the alerting tool and set `review.alert_resolved: true`. Run `scripts/validate-regression-test-first-bugfix-workflow.py --file` on the record.
step.output: Record validating with no violation; the 90-day review in the calendar.
step.decision-gate: The validator rejects the record: fix the record, not the rule (r-alert-closed-after-recurrence-window).

step.name: hotfix-variant-or-close-the-loop
step.input: Either the SLA decision from step 1, or the alerting tool's issue page at `review.next_review_at`.
step.action: Hotfix: ship the smallest fix with `fix.hotfix: true`, set `red_test.status: pending`, `red_test.follow_up_ticket_url` and `red_test.due_at` no later than `merged_at` + 14 days, keep the alert open (`alert_resolved: false`) until the test merges, then run steps 2-6 from the ticket. Review: at `next_review_at` fill `review.outcome` with the regression events for the issue in the window and whether a new issue with the same stack signature exists.
step.output: Either a pending record with its follow-up ticket, or a reviewed record with `outcome`.
step.decision-gate: A regression event inside the window reopens the record: a new red test for the new inputs is written before any second fix (r-hotfix-variant-carries-follow-up, r-alert-closed-after-recurrence-window).

list.item: Record validates via `scripts/validate-regression-test-first-bugfix-workflow.py` with no violation.
Two CI runs are cited: the test-only commit failing for the alert's reason, and the complete PR passing.
`next_review_at` is `merged_at` + 90 days, and a pending red test has a follow-up due within 14 days with the alert still open.
